summary: Focused implementing-agent review of revision18. All 30 packaged files match source. Watch recovery validates review reason before mutation, checks shared revision and remote plan, uses one GUS update for Path-to-Green plus health comments, verifies both and preserves drafts/history before applying shared Review Status. Retry does not duplicate the latest matching entry. Popup retains text on error and cancel is non-mutating. Tooltips wrap unbroken URLs, size to available space/content, keep Summary controls clear and settle after scrolling. Three focused tests and one isolated browser flow passed. Not an independent review.
caveats: Actual hosted GUS write permissions and production model outputs remain unverified; testing uses an isolated backend.
A successful GUS write followed by shared dashboard revision/storage failure may require refresh and review; the popup retains text and reports failure.
REST conditional writes are used where exposed; facade-only writes retain the existing pre-save/post-save protection without atomic guarantees.
The new monthly recovery entry is append-only and preserves original rich history; older history may include earlier recovery plans. No broad suite was run.
